title: Pooling Nasopharyngeal Swab Specimens for SARS-CoV-2 Testing by RT-PCR
author: Handous, Hannachi, et al.
materials: The study was approved by the ethics committee and medical research of the Farhat Hached University Hospital, Sousse, Tunisia (Reference number IRB00008931). This study was an evaluation of laboratory techniques using conserved clinical specimens.

RNA was extracted from 0.140 mL of each individual and pooled specimen using the QIAamp viral RNA mini kit in conjunction with a QIAcube (QIAGEN, Hilden, Germany) following the manufacturer’s instructions. PCR amplification was performed using the Primerdesign Ltd. COVID-19 genesig assay targeting the (ORF1ab) genome region on the Applied Biosystem 7500 Real-Time PCR System (Applied Biosystems, Foster City, CA, USA) according to the manufacturers’ instruction. PCR was performed in duplicate (replicates I and II) for each extracted specimen. RNA internal extraction control was used to identify PCR inhibition and to evaluate RNA extraction purity and integrity of the PCR run. The detection limit of ORF1ab was ≤0.33 copies/μL. To improve the sensitivity of the pooling method, the number of cycles has been increased to 50. According to the laboratory’s protocol, samples with Ct > 36 that tested weakly positive with only one of the replicates are defined as inconclusive and required confirmation by retesting.

steps.title: Collect and pool specimens
steps.instruction: Collect 0.140 mL of each nasopharyngeal swab sample; combine the aliquots to form the pooled specimen as required.

steps.title: Extract RNA with QIAcube
steps.instruction: Load each 0.140 mL individual or pooled specimen onto the QIAamp Viral RNA Mini Kit in the QIAcube and run the extraction following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare RT‑PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the COVID‑19 genesig assay (Primerdesign Ltd.) targeting the ORF1ab region on an Applied Biosystems 7500 Real‑Time PCR System, adding the RNA template, primers, probes, and reagents exactly as specified by the assay manufacturer.

steps.title: Run reactions in duplicate
steps.instruction: Set up two replicate reactions (Replicate I and Replicate II) for each extracted RNA sample and place them on the 7500 instrument.

steps.title: Include internal extraction control
steps.instruction: Add the RNA internal extraction control to each reaction to monitor PCR inhibition and assess RNA purity and run integrity.

steps.title: Configure PCR cycling parameters
steps.instruction: Program the PCR to run the manufacturer‑specified cycling conditions, but increase the total number of cycles to 50 to improve pooling sensitivity.

steps.title: Interpret Ct values
steps.instruction: Record the cycle threshold (Ct) for the ORF1ab gene; if a sample shows Ct > 36 and only one of the two replicates is positive, classify it as inconclusive and repeat testing.
